description: Fetch the full advisory record for an OSV vulnerability ID. Returns the complete record: summary, full details text, CVE aliases, all affected packages and version ranges, fix versions, CVSS severity vectors, CWE weakness IDs, and references. Use when osv_query_package or osv_query_batch returns a vuln ID and you need the full advisory context — eligibility criteria, scope of affected packages, or remediation guidance. Large records return overflow with same-tool page pointers; every omitted field remains retrievable.

id.description: One exact, complete OSV advisory ID from any OSV source database, matched case-sensitively. Prefixes include "GHSA-" (GitHub), "PYSEC-" (PyPI), "RUSTSEC-" (Rust), "GO-" (Go), "DSA-"/"DLA-" (Debian), "USN-" (Ubuntu), "RHSA-" (Red Hat), and "CVE-". No wildcards or partial IDs — take IDs from osv_query_package or osv_query_batch results. Example: "GHSA-29mw-wpgm-hmr9".

page.description: Retrieve an announced pointer; repeat id and continue with nextOffset and revision.

offset.description: Entry offset, or Unicode code-point offset for text.

path.description: RFC 6901 pointer into normalized output; empty string selects its root.

revision.description: Revision returned for this node; omit on first retrieval.

name: osv_get_vulnerability

affected.description: All affected packages and their version ranges. An advisory may span multiple packages or ecosystems.

ecosystem.description: Affected package ecosystem. Empty for source-only advisories.

packageName.description: Affected package name. Empty for source-only advisories (GIT ranges with no package identity).

events.description: Ordered event boundaries defining the affected interval(s) — the loss-free view preserving multiple introduced/fixed pairs the scalar fields collapse.

value.description: Version string or commit identifier at this boundary.

fixed.description: The last "fixed" event of this range (convenience view — a multi-interval range carries several; see events[]).

introduced.description: First affected version (convenience view — the last "introduced" event; see events[] for full interval order).

lastAffected.description: Last affected version when no fix exists (convenience view — see events[]).

repo.description: Source repository URL for GIT ranges. Absent on version ranges.

severity.description: Severity entries scoped to this package. Present only when the advisory scores packages separately; the record-level severity is then empty.

score.description: CVSS vector string, or the Ubuntu priority (e.g. "medium") for type "Ubuntu".

versions.description: Explicit affected versions enumerated by the advisory. Absent or empty when affected versions are expressed only as ranges.

aliases.description: Alternative IDs — usually CVE IDs. Accepted by nvd_get_cve on nist-nvd-mcp-server for CVSS base score, EPSS exploitation probability, and CISA KEV status.

items.description: An alternative ID (usually a CVE ID).

cweIds.description: CWE weakness classifications (e.g. ["CWE-79"]). Present on GitHub Advisory Database records; empty otherwise.

details.description: Full advisory text, typically in Markdown. May include proof-of-concept, reproduction steps, or remediation guidance.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_page_path`: The pointer is unknown or cannot fit a bounded page. `stale_page_revision`: The re-fetched node changed after its revision was announced. `vulnerability_not_found`: The requested OSV ID does not exist in the database. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

overflow.description: Transmission overflow disclosure; independent of upstream truncation.

complete.description: Complete top-level fields retained in this response.

notice.description: Transmission omission and fresh re-fetch semantics.

omitted.description: Omitted values, all addressable through page.path.

items.description: An oversized child; parent offset advances past this descriptor.

path.description: Exact child pointer to retrieve separately.

total.description: Number of child entries or Unicode code points; one for scalars.

page.description: First retrieval arguments; repeat the original tool input.

offset.description: Entry offset, or Unicode code-point offset for text.

path.description: RFC 6901 pointer into normalized output; empty string selects its root.

revision.description: Revision returned for this node; omit on first retrieval.

page.description: One bounded page of an addressed normalized node.

entries.description: Source-order entries for arrays, objects and scalars.

items.description: One source entry, complete or deferred.

deferred.description: Retrievable child descriptor when its value does not fit.

path.description: Exact child pointer to retrieve separately.

total.description: Number of child entries or Unicode code points; one for scalars.

key.description: Object key or original array index.

nextOffset.description: Next offset, strictly greater or null when finished.

notice.description: Fresh re-fetch disclosure; no saved historical snapshot.

revision.description: SHA-256 revision of the addressed normalized node; batch collection uses original input order.

text.description: Verbatim Unicode code-point slice for strings.

total.description: Total entries or Unicode code points.

preview.description: Compact view; overflow identifies omissions. This is not the complete record.

references.description: Advisory references — NVD links, patches, vendor advisories, PoC reports.

schemaVersion.description: OSV schema version this record conforms to (e.g. "1.7.3").

severity.description: Record-level severity entries (CVSS vectors, Ubuntu priorities). Empty for unscored advisories and for advisories that score each affected package separately.

score.description: CVSS vector string, or the Ubuntu priority (e.g. "medium") for type "Ubuntu".

severityLabel.description: Severity label ("LOW", "MODERATE", "HIGH", "CRITICAL") from the first source that yields one: database_specific.severity, an Ubuntu priority, then the highest CVSS v3/v4 score (0.1–3.9 LOW, 4.0–6.9 MODERATE, 7.0–8.9 HIGH, 9.0–10.0 CRITICAL). Uses every affected package severity entry when the record-level list is empty. Null when no source yields a label.

computedScore.description: CVSS score computed from the vector as published: a CVSS 4.0 vector over every metric group it carries (threat and environmental included), a CVSS 3.x vector with its temporal metrics. Present only for CVSS sources.

score.description: The published value the label came from: the database_specific.severity text, the Ubuntu priority, or the CVSS vector.

type.description: Source kind: the database_specific.severity label, an Ubuntu priority, or a CVSS vector.

severitySource.description: The severity entry severityLabel was derived from. Null exactly when the label is.

withdrawn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this advisory was withdrawn. Present ONLY on withdrawn advisories — a withdrawn record has been retracted and must not be treated as an active vulnerability.
